KNIGHT'S THRESHOLD, and Harris's whole timing argument. General Average 'could function well under uncertainty, even high uncertainty' because nothing is priced before the event - which is why it predates premium insurance by a millennium or more. THE LIMIT Harris names: it 'provided no relief in the event of sinking and total loss', where there is nothing left to average.
STRUCTURALLY CERTAIN: mortality risk is mutualised among subscribers and no outsider bears it - the state pays a fixed total and survivors divide it. Coded on structure, not on a source.

THE FALSIFICATION TEST, NOT YET RUNNABLE. If the hazard-to-pricing sequence holds, pooling forms should code PR1=0. The tontine is the candidate counter-example: subscribers grouped into age classes is ex-ante actuarial pricing inside a pooling form. If it codes PR1=1 the sequence collapses and pricing is orthogonal to mechanism rather than a stage of it. TWO PROBLEMS FIRST: (i) no source to hand - Harris 2023 does not treat tontines, and coding this from general knowledge would breach the repo's own rule; (ii) 'tontine' probably spans pre- and post-actuarial forms, so one row may not hold it and the type may need splitting by period.

Harris's category applies on structure: mortality risk is mutualised among subscribers, the state pays a fixed total, no outsider bears it. Coded on structure, not on a source - the caveat inherited from LM-0077 stands.

THE DISCRIMINATING CELL, half of it. No differentiation by nominee age: a single rate irrespective of the life named, which is why nominees were selected young and why Halley advised against the scheme. Pairs with tontine_fr_royal PR1=1 - same mechanism, same decade, opposite value. Vault: [[Pricing is orthogonal to mitigation mechanism not a stage of it]].

THE STRUCTURAL POINT. Survivors draw irrespective of any loss suffered. This is the cell separating the tontine from general_average (individual-indemnity) and from averia_pool (collective-good): the draw corresponds to no adverse realisation of the recipient's, so the arrangement concentrates a fixed aggregate onto long trajectories.

CHARACTERISTIC INADEQUATE - coded under protest. The trigger is ANOTHER subscriber's death, not the recipient's own life event, and PY1's allowed values name the kind of event without a locator. As coded this reads identically to widows_fund_scotland PY1, where the trigger is the member's own. Sereno well-formedness failure (CHARACTER-CODING test 1); split proposed in logbook 6.

No allowed value expresses survivorship accrual: rotation-lot, rotation-fixed, auction, indemnity and need-assessed all miss it. Recorded .NR rather than forced into the nearest wrong value. Depends on the PY1 repair.

Mortality across unrelated nominees is about as decorrelated as an early modern hazard gets. NOTE THE IMPLICATION: the tontine PASSES the correlation test that averia_pool fails (HZ1=covariate) and is variance-amplifying anyway. Correlation and redistribution direction are independent failure modes, which HZ1 alone cannot show.
A subscription, not a levy. Contrast averia_pool MB3=compulsory.
A single subscription buying a share in the survivorship pool.
Exposure ends at the sum subscribed.
Runs until the last nominee dies. Neither single-event nor fixed-cycle fits; open-ended is the least wrong, and the poor fit is itself worth recording.

CORRECTED from 1 to P on Coudy 1957, now a pinned source. THE GRADING IS REAL: the 1689 edict fixes fourteen classes in five-year bands (first to age 5 accomplished, last from 65) and declares interest progressive - du denier 20 au denier 8 dans les treizieme et quatorzieme classes, i.e. 5 per cent rising to 12.5 per cent for the oldest. 1696 adds a fifteenth class from 70; 1709 has twenty. BUT THE GRADING IS NOT ACTUARIAL: Coudy gives the purpose as 'dans un but d'equite' and states flatly that 'l'on ne disposait d'aucune table de mortalite. L'on ne s'en souciait guere non plus' - no mortality table existed and nobody much minded. He doubts the Crown grasped the real cost. So the peril is priced ex ante by age band and NOT from any distribution, which is P and not 1 - the same reading as sea_loan PR1=P, where Harris finds crude pricing sufficient. DECISIVE FOR DIRECTION: Deparcieux (1746) DERIVED survival probabilities by observing the 1689 and 1696 tontines, so the actuarial knowledge came out of these instruments rather than into them.
as tontine_en_1693 - the pricing differs, the payout structure does not, which is the point
as tontine_en_1693

Experience-rated: contributions set against projected mortality and fund accumulation (Webster and Wallace). The other half of the PR1-within-pooling variance - and unlike tontine_fr_royal it is loss-corresponding, so pricing and payout direction vary independently across these two forms.

THE CONTRAST WITH THE TONTINE. Same period, same mechanism category, priced ex ante - and the draw follows the member's own realised loss rather than others' extinction. This is the cell on which the two forms diverge and the reason they belong in the census together.

THE ACTUAL SITE OF THE PRICING STORY. De Witt's Waardije van Lyf-renten naer Proportie van Los-renten values life annuities against redeemable ones because Holland sold them at a flat fourteen years' purchase irrespective of the nominee's age and was arbitraged by parents nominating healthy children. Hudde supplied the Amsterdam registers; Halley 1693 supplied the survival function and the summed product of survival probability and discount factor.
inapplicable: not a fund with an output - cf. sea_loan LM-0033

Harris's category: contributions mutualised among the 46 members, no outsider bears anything, nothing paid to a third party. Note this sits oddly with the form's actual function — see PR1 and the adjudications.

Membership constituted by the 規約書 (rules of association), not by locality: 表1 places members across present-day Higashi-Osaka, Yao, Kashiwara, Osaka city and Kyoto. Locality would have been the expected value for a village kō and is falsified here.
口数46名 fixed in the rules; total 2,300円 at 50円 per share. Closed and numerically restricted. Half-shares (半株持) exist, so the unit is the share rather than the person.
A subscription under a private 規約書. Contrast averia_pool MB3=compulsory.
掛金 brought to each 講会, twice yearly (4/15 and 11/15). Fund pattern, not the general-average ex-post pattern.

Enforceable in the strong sense: on delinquency the deposited 田畑書入証 is used to collect principal plus interest at 月壱歩, with public auction (糶賈) of the mortgaged land. Litigation costs fall on 実方一同 — the members who have not yet drawn.

THE DISCRIMINATING CELL against the indemnity forms. A member receives the pot by auction irrespective of any loss suffered — 落札 determines the recipient, nothing else. Separates this form from general_average and widows_fund_scotland (individual-indemnity) and from averia_pool (collective-good).

THE LOT/BID FORK, RESOLVED FOR THIS FORM. 入札にて引方多ク方エ借用 — the pot goes to the lowest bidder, ties to whoever drew first. This is the bidding variant; the lot variant (rotation-lot) is the one still uncoded, and the two should not be smeared into one type.
The draw is a fixed 2,300円 irrespective of the recipient's circumstances. Capped by construction. Applicable because PY0 is individual-draw.

On default the residual runs first to the mortgaged land, then to the 加判人 (co-sealing sureties), then to the remaining sealers. Litigation costs explicitly on 実方一同. Pro-rata is the closest fit; the layered sequence is not fully expressible in this characteristic.

Entitlement exists and is conditional on attendance, which is a genuine partial state rather than a hedge.

The source discusses pricing at length: the auction sets the discount, and Ikeda notes 落札高により借入利率の格差が生じる, so an implicit interest rate is determined ex ante. But what is priced is CREDIT, not peril. 田中: 宝光院 solicited (要請) leading castle-town merchants to join. Invitation, not levy.
天保三壬辰年四月初メ / 十月 / 壱年毎度宛 — meetings from the fourth month of Tenpō 3 (1832), then the tenth month, annually thereafter.

As tanomoshi_oya: the association is organised around raising capital for 堂宇修築, not around a peril. No hazard whose correlation could be asked about.

NO FITTING VALUE, same gap as tanomoshi_oya GV1. The 講元 is the temple, simultaneously organiser and principal beneficiary. Neither collective, elder-fixed, nor external-administered describes an insider-organiser who is also the intended recipient. 田中's own term is 寺社を講元とする頼母子講.

Credit is priced and peril is not — same reading as tanomoshi_oya PR1. Rates are explicit in 表4 (利率20両ニ付1分, 利金6両 on 元金20両) and in 史料10 (利足金弐分弐朱宛). No probability of any peril enters. Observed absence of ex-ante PERIL pricing, not silence.
広域講 (multi-village kō), 講元 碓井村伴吾 of the 松倉 house — 下館藩石川氏河内領大庄屋 and 代官 of a 旗本知行所. Mutualised among members; no outsider bears anything.

Subscription under a 仕法帳. No levy.
壱ヶ年ニ会両度ツヽ相勤 — two 参会 per year.

当選銀 goes to the winner of each round irrespective of any loss.
一、御当鬮又ハ落札之御方者、其会限リニ御退可被成候事 — a member who has won retires from subsequent draws, so entitlement is strictly positional.

NO FITTING VALUE — AND THIS IS THE FINDING, NOT A GAP. 一、…尤初会入札、弐会目振鬮、終リ迄一会替リニいたし、廿五会相勤 — the first round is decided by BID (入札), the second by LOT (振鬮), alternating to the twenty-fifth. Allocation is not a property of the association; it alternates by round. PY2 admits one nominal value per form and cannot express this. Recorded .NR rather than forced to auction or rotation-lot.

一、…廿五会相勤、残リ五人江銀子配分之事, and in the account: 弐拾六会 残リ五人江銀子配分也 但シ壱人前壱貫七百六拾匁ツヽ — the five who never drew receive 1貫760匁 each at the twenty-sixth. Members hold a genuine residual claim. Contrast tontine_en_1693, where non-survivors receive nothing.

Residual distributed to the five undrawn members at the 弐拾六会.

Here 銀預り are 古市村金銅久兵衛, 岡村岡田伊左衛門, 軽墓村塩野久右衛門. Neither collective, elder-fixed, nor external-administered describes a convenor-plus-steward split.
一、会毎ニ銀子入用之御方ハ、三人之連判ニ而、月八朱之利足と相定、貸附之事 — pooled 掛銀 is lent out at eight 朱 per month against three co-signatures. Credit is priced ex ante; peril is not, and none is pooled.
No peril is pooled — the association raises and circulates capital. As tanomoshi_oya and tanomoshi_shaji.
文政12 (1829) 「四拾人講定目録」, the most detailed surviving 広域講 仕法帳. 世話方/銀預り: 古市村久兵衛, 誉田村慶治, 弥三右衛門.

Drafted by 銀預り overlapping with those of ko_usui_bango_1822, which alternates bid and lot. Two associations, the same drafting circle, the same district, one decade apart, and different allocation rules — so the rule is a drafting choice, not a property of the tradition.
壱ヶ年ニ会三度宛相勤 — three meetings a year, 毎年会月、三月・七月・十一月. More frequent than ko_usui_bango_1822's two.

一、初会 満会迄…都合拾三ヶ年半ニ満会相成候事 — forty-one rounds over thirteen and a half years to 満会.
Same two-tier gap as ko_usui_bango_1822. The 仕法帳 cover names the drafters 世話方, and 米谷 notes 銀預り were sometimes so called — the steward role is emic and has no cell.
大満院 is a 子院 within 誉田八幡宮. 初会 inferred as 文政11 (1828) from the per-round 掛銀 schedule; the tenth round fell in 天保4 (1833).3.

As ko_usui_bango_1822: 米谷 finds rules one to five substantially identical to that association's, and the 掛銀 and 当選銀 schedules nearly the same, because 岡田伊左衛門 and 塩野久右衛門 served as 銀預り and drafted the 仕法 for both. Alternating allocation therefore inherited, and equally inexpressible.

Contributions mutualised among members with no outsider taking the risk, so Harris's category holds on structure. But see PY3 and the CN1 note: this form retains almost nothing of the mutual-aid rationale, and 並松 places it with 富籤 as 無尽本来の特徴である救済的あるいは相互扶助的な金融組織から著しく逸脱したもの.

THE CELL THAT SEPARATES IT FROM THE VILLAGE FORMS. 並松: the 講元(世話人) recruits 血縁・地縁にまったく関係なく、広く講員を募って — with no kin or locality tie whatever. Membership is constituted purely by subscription. Contrast the village kō, where 松永 finds kō built on 親戚・知人・取引相手・信仰.
辻六郎左衛門's 無尽仕法帳 of 文政7年8月 is a 十年・六〇人の取退無尽 — sixty members over ten years, with 備後町三丁目銭屋源兵衛 named as 世話方. One documented instance; the general case is not enumerated.
Open subscription, canvassed widely.

CHARACTERISTIC INADEQUATE — the timing is right and the duration is unexpressible. Contributions fall due periodically, so ex-ante-periodic is correct as far as it goes. But the defining feature of this form is that a member who wins is 次回以降の掛戻義務から免れ — released from all further contribution — while the kō continues on the 未当籤講員. In every other coded association (池田's 持寄融通社, 米谷's 伴吾講 and 四拾人講) the winner keeps paying 空掛 to 満会. CN1 asks when contributions fall due and is silent on how long a member owes them. See logbook 6.
Equal periodic 掛金 per share, as in the other forms. Not separately attested for this variant.
A draw irrespective of loss, as with the other rotating forms.
Entitlement is positional: one draw per member, then exit from the obligation.

抽籤 — lot, not bid. NOTE THE CONSEQUENCE: because allocation is by lot, the liquidity-transfer mechanism that operates in bidding kō is absent here. This form is regressive for a different reason, namely that an early draw yields far more relative to contributions than a late one — 当籤が早ければ掛金額に比して給付額が多くなり、遅ければその逆 — which 並松 calls 射倖性が非常に強い. Lot removes the sorting by urgency and replaces it with sorting by chance.

CAPPED, and the cap is what keeps the form alive. 当籤者に対する給付額が講金のすべてというわけではなく、講金の一部を給付することによって、組織としての持続性が保たれる — the winner receives only part of the pot, and the retained remainder is what allows the association to continue once winners stop contributing.
十年 in 辻六郎左衛門's 仕法帳. A closed run, though shorter than the village cycles.

No peril is priced; nothing resembling one is pooled. 中川 records that one ground for prosecution was the 講元 taking 幕府規定の利子制限をはるかに超える高利潤 — returns far above the shogunate's interest ceilings — so credit was priced, and priced abusively. Peril was not, and there is none here.
Same convenor-plus-steward gap as the other Japanese associations. 中川 names 銭屋源兵衛 as 世話方 for 辻's kō; 並松 uses 講元(世話人) interchangeably. No value expresses an insider-organiser distinct from a steward.
No peril pooled, so no correlation to report. As the other Japanese forms.

HELD OPEN DELIBERATELY. The flood-spreading reading is the received view in the Japanese literature (Furushima 1939; Aono 1982), built on individual village studies. Brown 2006 tests it regionally with GIS and concludes that flood and landslide frequency 'must be seen as insufficient causes by themselves, even if scholars ultimately see them as necessary conditions'. Coding pooling here would enter a contested orthodoxy as data; coding 0 or allocation would enter Brown's negative as a positive. See logbook 6 and vault [[Brown tests equality where a risk reading predicts dispersion]].
Participation follows village membership and shareholding within the village, not kinship, occupation or contract. Iwade's shares were fixed at sixteen by the end of the seventeenth century.

Sixteen shares, fixed by the late seventeenth century and constant thereafter; each wari was generally divided into sixteen sections for which lots were drawn. NOTE: the share count did not track the number of families, so 'membership' is a share, not a household.

A shareholder could not opt out of a redistribution once the village conducted one — but see the hikikuji note at PY2. Coded medium because the source of the obligation varied: some domains (Kaga) regulated joint control by law, elsewhere the practice was village initiative, and Brown 2006 argues for 'local, village-level human agency'.

INAPPLICABLE, AND STRUCTURALLY IMPORTANT. Warichi has no contribution stream and accumulates no fund. It reallocates an existing asset rather than assembling one. Every other form in this census — averia_pool, general_average, the tanomoshi associations, the tontines — collects something. This is the cell on which warichi is unlike all of them, and it is why the pooling category sits awkwardly.
Inapplicable: no contribution to measure. Propagates from CN1.
Inapplicable: no contribution to enforce. Propagates from CN1.

NOT RECORDED BECAUSE THE TEST WAS INCONCLUSIVE. Brown mapped 113 villages (110 geolocated) against elevation and drainage and found anomalies: the Shindōri, Kamegai and Sekiya intervals near the Shinano mouth 'cannot be explained by readily apparent natural conditions', Iwade practises warichi while 'removed from a large hydrological system and floodplain', and most of the sample lies above 67.5 metres. Coding a correlation value here would assert what he could not establish.
Not addressed. Flood and landslide are indifferent to the defence mounted, which would suggest 0, but Brown does not treat responsiveness and the hazard's role is itself unsettled (HZ1).

CHARACTERISTIC FITS AWKWARDLY. Each shareholder receives an allocation by lot irrespective of any loss suffered, which is individual-draw. But unlike every rotating form in this census, ALL members draw simultaneously at each redistribution rather than one member per round — there is no queue and no 'turn'. The value is right about the trigger and wrong about the structure.
Entitlement follows the redistribution cycle rather than a realised loss or a life event. Same caveat as PY0: the cycle allocates to everyone at once.

THE BEST-ATTESTED CELL. Allocation by drawn lot: the village kept 'Lot Exchange Notebooks' (kujikae chō), and in 1756-1757 the sixteen shares were organised into nine lot-drawing groups (kujigumi). CAVEAT WITH NO CELL OF ITS OWN: hikikuji, the right to withhold land from redistribution, ran from under 2 per cent of village land in 1756-57 to 14 per cent in 1818, exceeded the 5 per cent Kaga permitted, and 'the rights to withhold were concentrated in a few hands, not universally shared'. An opt-out from the allocation mechanism has no representation in this vocabulary.
Inapplicable: there is no fund and therefore no surplus on which a residual claim could be held. Propagates from CN1.

Brown describes redistribution outcomes as 'a product of discussion and consensus building during each redistribution', and 2006 concludes for 'an important role for local, village-level human agency'. Contrast the Japanese rotating associations, where a 講元 convenes and a 銀預り administers.

Periodic redistribution at village-specific intervals — five years in the four Nadachi coastal villages, ten in the nine upstream, with a full interval series compiled for 113 villages. The interval is the parameter Brown devotes a chapter to measuring, and on a resetting reading it is the only free parameter the institution has.
Terminal distribution not addressed; the cycle repeats rather than terminating. Warichi ended with the Meiji land tax reform rather than by internal completion.
Inapplicable: no advance is made, so nothing secures one.

OBSERVED ABSENCE. Nothing is priced anywhere in the institution — no premium, no bid, no interest, no ex-ante valuation of the peril. Land was assessed for quality when wari sections were laid out, but that is a measurement of the asset, not a price on a peril. Consistent with every pooling form in the census except the age-classed tontine.

NO FITTING VALUE, AND THAT IS THE POINT. Harris's three mechanisms — allocation, spreading, pooling — are all ways of moving a loss. Particular average moves it nowhere: the damage 'falls to the owner of the damaged goods on account of the maxim casum sentit dominum'. It is the null against which the other three are defined, not a fourth alternative. Not coded 'allocation': that value means risk assigned to a named party BY CONTRACT, whereas this is a default rule operating in the absence of any arrangement.

THE DISCRIMINATING CELL AGAINST general_average. Peril loss stays with the owner of the damaged goods. Contrast general_average RB1=all-stakeholders. Same voyage, same hull, same peril — and the incidence turns entirely on whether the damage was 'consciously sought out with the intention of avoiding a more serious one' (general) or came 'from an irresistible or unforeseeable external cause' (particular).
Market risk likewise remains with the goods' owner; nothing in the doctrine transfers it. Coded medium: the sources address peril, not price.

No advance is made, so nothing secures one. NOTE the contractual override: Zanini shows that under a bottomry contract, particular-average damage reduced the borrower's repayment obligation proportionally, 'since the relative risk had been transferred to the lender'. The default rule is displaceable by contract, and the sea loan is one instrument that displaces it.
Inapplicable: no obligation is advanced, so none is discharged. See the bottomry note at RB3 for the contractual case, which belongs to sea_loan rather than here.
Inapplicable: there is no fund and no output. Nothing is collected and nothing is distributed.
Inapplicable: propagates from PY0.
Inapplicable: propagates from PY0.
Inapplicable: no contribution is levied at any time, before or after the event. This is the cell on which particular average differs from general_average (ex-post-assessment) most starkly.
Inapplicable: propagates from CN1.
Inapplicable: propagates from CN1.
Inapplicable: there is no membership to join, voluntarily or otherwise. Whoever owns damaged goods bears the damage; no one participates.
Inapplicable: no pool exists whose exhaustion could raise the question.
Inapplicable: there is no contribution beyond which liability could extend. The owner's exposure is his goods, entire.

UNSETTLED, AND THE INTERESTING CELL. A particular-average loss requires no verification within the sharing institution, since nothing is shared. But the CLASSIFICATION does — Dreijer notes the distinction was drawn 'particularly for insurers as they had to distinguish between the two to determine their contribution to damages'. So verification attaches to the boundary rather than to the loss, and VF1 has no way to say so. Addobbati holds the boundary itself unverifiable: deliberateness is 'an internal act' attested only by 'the master who makes the damage declaration'.

No peril is priced, because no peril is transferred. Consistent with general_average PR1=0 and averia_pool PR1=0 — the whole family prices nothing ex ante — but here for the opposite reason: not because calculation is deferred to an ex-post assessment, but because there is no assessment at all.
Inapplicable: a default rule of loss incidence has no duration. Contrast general_average DR1=single-event, which is struck for one voyage and one sacrifice.

Not recorded. The doctrine is indifferent to whether the peril is idiosyncratic or covariate; it turns on human causality against external randomness, which is a different axis from correlation across members.

NO FITTING VALUE, AND THAT IS THE FINDING. Allocation, spreading and pooling all presuppose that a loss is being moved among parties with a stake. Here nothing is mitigated: 小林 finds the association was 強制的に組織して返済を期待せず直接藩財政に入れてしまった — compulsorily organised, no repayment expected, receipts going straight into domain finances — and calls it 献金講 とも呼ぶべきもの, a donation kō, 御未進取立講に近い仕法. A kō in form and a levy in function. Third form in this census whose MC1 cannot be set (with warichi_iwade and particular_average).

Membership follows residence on the Iino domain's portion of 長興寺村 rather than kinship, occupation or subscription. Both 高持 and 無高 households were enrolled — some 100 persons for a village assessment of roughly 166 koku.

強制的に集めた. 小林 reads the domain's ability to compel a hundred-odd members as evidence that 藩権力の余力がまだ多少残っていた. COMPULSION WAS RESISTIBLE, THOUGH: neighbouring 岡部藩 ordered compulsory enrolment in a クジ頼母子 across four districts in 寛政3 (1791) and the villages refused, pleading 凶作による困窮, and likewise refused a 用金 levy of 2両 per 100石.

Twice yearly in the fourth and ninth months for this association; the preceding 御殿様頼母子講 met always in the eleventh. 小林 reads the 大黒屋 timing as accommodating the agricultural calendar somewhat more than its predecessor.

NO FITTING VALUE — THE ASSESSMENT IS A TWO-PART TARIFF AND CN2 ADMITS ONE BASIS. Contributions divide into 高割 (proportional to assessed landholding, 2匁5分 down to 8分 per koku by year) PLUS 家割 (a flat per-household charge of 3匁, 2匁2分2厘, 1匁9分, 1匁5分). Neither 'equal' nor 'proportional-to-stake' describes the sum, and the interaction between the two parts is precisely where the regressivity lives — see the note at LM-TTTT-06. A composite assessment has no representation in this vocabulary.

THE SUBSTANTIVE FINDING, RECORDED HERE FOR WANT OF A CELL FOR IT. The landless paid no 高掛り but were charged 家割 — and 無高上層 were charged 1分 to 2分2厘 MORE flat charge than 高持百姓, with a further 無高下 stratum below them paying 8分 to 1匁 less than 無高上層. 小林's own verdict: 石高が多いほど実質的な負担は少なくなり、無高ほど実質的な負担が多くなる。すなわち累進ではなくて逆進となってまことに不公平である. A flat charge laid over a proportional one, falling hardest on those with least, inside an institution his title calls the source of mutual-aid thought. He does not reconcile the two.

NO OUTPUT TO MEMBERS. Not collective-good (nothing non-excludable is bought for the members, unlike averia_pool's armed escort), not indemnity, not a draw: receipts entered domain finances and 小林 finds no expectation of repayment — たとえ借上とはいっても実際には返済しないもの. PY1-PY3 left uncoded rather than propagated .NA, since .NA would assert a PY0 value not established.
大黒屋善兵衛 was 町方の商人 acting 藩の命をうけて — a townsman merchant convening on the domain's orders. 小林: 個人名を冠してはいるが、藩営頼母子、すなわち岩橋勝教授が称される領主的金融講であった. The personal name on the ledger conceals a domain instrument.

Nine meetings are recorded in the 銀集帳 between 嘉永元 (1848) and 嘉永6 (1853); 掛銀 falls across them from 700目 to 238目. Sources fail after the ninth, and a third association was begun the following year at 675目.

Nothing is priced ex ante in this association. NOTE A CONTRASTING DOMAIN, THOUGH: 小林 records that 高槻藩, from 文久2 (1862), ran a kō in which ある一定収支のモデル計算がなされていて、収益の多寡を判定して、それを藩財政に繰入している — an ex-ante model calculation of income and expenditure, profitability judged before commitment, at 25,000 shares. That is calculation inside a 領主的金融講 and would code differently.

Closed to the village: roughly 100 participants drawn from 高持 and 無高 households of 長興寺村. 無高 approached 40 per cent of the membership, and the 無高下 share of them fell from 41 per cent at the first meeting to 22 per cent at the ninth.

Enforceable through domain authority, which is what compulsory enrolment of a hundred households implies. Coded medium: no 議定 or 仕法書 survives, so the sanction is inferred from the fact of compulsion rather than read from a clause.
No peril is pooled. As with the other Japanese associations in this census, the arrangement moves capital rather than mitigating a hazard.
